Recreate @ Video1 exactly — identical camera framing, camera movement, shot timing, environment, lighting, color grade, and every motion beat of @ Video1 reproduced one-to-one on the same timeline. The character is lit and graded by the scene of @ Video1  itself — same key light direction, same grain, same depth of field — sitting seamlessly inside the original footage.
